fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study Plan You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Passport-sized photo * 3. Scanned copy of passport home page Ordinary passport with more than one year remaining validity; Applicants currently residing in China also need to provide a scanned copy of the current valid visa page or residence permit page. * 4. Non-criminal record report Issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application. * 5. Certificate of HSK * 6. Scanned copy of high school diploma/ graduation certificate For the graduates to obtain their degrees, they should submit a pre-graduation certificate to guarantee that they have the competence to complete their studies and acquire the degree by July. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized English translations. * 7. Scanned copies of high school transcripts for each semester/ academic year Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized English translations. * 8. Financial guarantee letter You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Foreigner Physical Examination Form The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please select the appropriate time to take a physical examination as the result is valid for only 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens, physically and mentally healthy; Applicants shall hold a high school diploma before September 1, 2026; Applicants should not be older than 25; Applicants’ academic grade in the previous stage should not be less than 75%; Applicants shall complete the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) prior to the application deadline. Relevant test subjects, download here . Applicants for Chinese-taught Programs should have the Chinese proficiency of HSK 4 or above. Applicants who previously held Chinese citizenship shall have obtained foreign nationality and renounced their Chinese nationality before April 30, 2022. Additionally, they shall have resided abroad for more than 2 years between April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (Record of actual foreign residency for 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, referring to the entry and exit date signatures).
